title: Two control surfaces mature: experiment safety and physical-agent interfaces
dek: Two narrow but decision-relevant extensions: one brings targeting and early-harm intervention closer to creator experiments; the other proposes an agent-facing abstraction for heterogeneous physical equipment.

title: Product judgment in the age of cheap AI capability
dek: Five developments across agent distribution, vertical adoption, product analytics, provenance, and portfolio discipline—examined for what is genuinely new and what changes a senior PM decision.
